knowledge.purpose: Placeholder shimmer block displayed while real content is loading
useCases: Loading state for a list row or a row of cards
Card skeleton while async data is fetched
antiPatterns: Determinate progress — a skeleton says only that content is coming, never how much of it
Empty-state messaging — use the callout pattern or text.alert
Permanent placeholder content — render the real block disabled instead
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- List loading state before items arrive

jsonSchema.description: The frame's width: a number is px, a string a CSS length ("100%", "12rem"). Left out, it fills the row. A text frame's last line is 60% of it; a circle without height takes it as its size.

The frame's height, in the same units as width: a number is px, a string a CSS length. Left out: a rectangle 20px, a card 120px, a circle 48px (text lines are always 16px). Size it to what loads in its place, so the page does not shift when the data arrives.
